steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. Going by the two listings, they're the same offer.

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Same | Same |

The product is the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 in graphite, and both listings describe it identically. The two pages also show the same rating and review count. That may mean the reviews belong to the product and not to the seller. If so, they tell you nothing about how reliable either seller is.

Neither page gives a reason to prefer one seller. Before you pay, you could check a few things the listings don't cover:
- **Seller reputation:** Look for independent reviews of Ottervale Audio and Brackmoor Sound, such as on Trustpilot or Reddit. Check that each is an authorized Quellwyn retailer, because that can affect warranty coverage.
- **Checkout differences:** Look at the final total with tax, the payment options and the estimated delivery date. These can differ even when the listing doesn't show it.
- **Return policy details:** Look for restocking fees or conditions on returns, which the listings don't mention.

If those checks turn up nothing, pick either one. If you want a tiebreaker, choose the seller with the better independent reputation or the one that offers the payment method you prefer.
